requirements_summary: Workload: high-volume content generation for email + landing pages; many short prompts with common prefixes.
Throughput target: up to 400 requests/sec during batch generation windows; sustained daily volume ~200k requests.
Latency SLO: interactive editor <500ms median; batch jobs OK in 1-3s per item if batched efficiently.
Cost target: <$0.0006 per token for draft stage; higher for final generation and reranker steps.
Model preferences: open/quantized models for drafts, higher-capacity model for finalization and reranking.
Routing/fallback: want policy for fallback to cheaper model when cost budget hit; can accept lower quality for drafts.
Caching/batching: strong interest in prefix/KV caching for templates and automated batching recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
Security: SSO/SAML and audit logging required; SOC2 not mandatory for SMB but helpful for enterprise clients.
Integration notes: currently integrate output into internal campaign system via REST webhooks; prefer simple SDK onboarding.
